tools.notes: 0.1.20: run --bg --no-parent --outlive-parent keeps the launched session alive after the downstream session ends.

The lesson review gate is `plannotator review <worktree> --base <trunk> --diff-type merge-base --gate --json`, which prints {decision, message}; `plannotator guide import --guide --patch [--pr]` saves the guided review it lists; `plannotator inbox call get_guide_brief` gives the guide's method. The Inbox notice goes to the thread `factory lessons`.
